policy.rule: Preserve the laboratory/source-reported analyte name. Normalize only to the most specific Atlas record justified by that name and verified identity evidence.
policy.noStereoInference: Do not infer enantiomer or geometric configuration from a broad/common analyte label.
policy.parentConceptFallback: When a label is chemically broader than an Atlas stereospecific record, map to a parent/broad concept and mark identityResolution='partial'.
